scripts.setup: npm run env:init && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:all: npm run setup && npm run admin:ensure && npm run typecheck && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @atlas/api && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:db && npm run build
scripts.test:full: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage:gate && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:local
scripts.test:coverage:gate: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:check
